Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import os,struct
base='repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/test/fuzzing/fonts'
for fn in os.listdir(base):
 p=os.path.join(base,fn); data=open(p,'rb').read()
 if len(data)<12: continue
 try:
  num=struct.unpack('>H',data[4:6])[0]
  for i in range(num):
   off=12+i*16
   tag=data[off:off+4]
   if tag==b'kerx':
    toff=struct.unpack('>I',data[off+8:off+12])[0]; ln=struct.unpack('>I',data[off+12:off+16])[0]
    tab=data[toff:toff+ln]
    print('\n',fn,'size',len(data),'kerx off len',toff,ln,'hex',tab[:80].hex())
    if len(tab)>=20:
     ver,unused,count=struct.unpack('>HHI',tab[:8])
     print('ver count',ver,count)
     pos=8
     for j in range(min(count,3)):
      if len(tab)<pos+12: break
      slen,cov,tuple=struct.unpack('>III',tab[pos:pos+12])
      print(' sub',j,'pos',pos,'slen',slen,'cov',hex(cov),'type',cov&0xff,'tuple',tuple,'data',tab[pos:pos+min(slen,80)].hex())
      pos+=slen
 except Exception as e: pass
PY
